summary: Proposes the syntax of the Network Access Identifier, the user identity string submitted during PPP authentication, normally written like a username at a realm. It helps roaming users be routed to the right place. It is a proposed standard that was replaced by RFC 4282.

eli5.summary: It is like a name tag with your name and your home organization. A network reads it to know where to check who you are.

questions: what is a network access identifier
